meta.explain.rfe.next: The notice has a deadline. Answer everything it asks, before that date.
meta.explain.rfeAnswered: USCIS has your answer to their request.
meta.explain.rfeAnswered.next: Review picks back up. A decision usually follows.
meta.explain.biometrics.next: Bring the appointment notice and your ID. After this the file goes to review.
meta.explain.interview.next: The notice has the date and place. Bring originals of everything you filed.
meta.explain.interviewDone.next: A decision or a request for more evidence usually comes next.
meta.explain.review: An officer is working on your case.
meta.explain.review.next: This can last weeks or months. No action needed unless USCIS writes to you.
meta.explain.transferred: Your case moved to another office.
meta.explain.transferred.next: Normal and usually to balance workloads. Your dates don’t change.
meta.explain.approved.next: An approval notice is on its way. Cards are produced and mailed after it.
meta.explain.cardMade.next: It usually ships within a few weeks.
meta.explain.cardMailed: Your card is in the mail or delivered.
meta.explain.cardMailed.next: Check it for mistakes right away and report any.
meta.explain.rejected.next: Usually a missing fee, signature or field. Fix it and file again quickly.
meta.explain.denied.next: The notice explains why and whether you can appeal. Talk to an attorney soon.
meta.explain.returned: Mail from USCIS couldn’t reach you.
meta.explain.returned.next: Update your address with USCIS (Form AR-11) right away.
meta.explain.received.next: A receipt notice is mailed. Biometrics or review usually come next.
meta.packing.passport: Passport valid at least 6 months past your return
meta.packing.f1.visa: Valid F-1 visa stamp (or a stamping appointment abroad)
meta.packing.f1.i20: I-20 with a travel signature from the last 12 months
meta.packing.opt.i20: I-20 with a travel signature from the last 6 months
meta.packing.j1.ds2019: DS-2019 signed for travel by your sponsor
meta.packing.work.visa: Valid visa stamp, or a stamping appointment abroad
meta.packing.work.letter: Employment letter and recent pay stubs
meta.packing.family.i797: Your and your spouse’s latest I-797 notices
meta.packing.pending.ap: Advance parole document, unless you keep valid H or L status — leaving without it can abandon your I-485
meta.packing.gc.card: Green card (or I-551 stamp / extension notice)
meta.packing.gc.trips: Trips under 6 months protect continuous residence; a re-entry permit for 1 year or longer
